title: Digital Nitrogen Tyre Inflator - NITROJET 1000 LCV P / NITROJET 1000 LCV H
description: Digital nitrogen tyre inflator with N2 only option or N2 with Air option, featuring three digital readouts.
subtitle: N2 Only option / N2 with Air option
fullDescription: Digital nitrogen tyre inflator available in two variants: N2 only option (NITROJET 1000 LCV P) and N2 with Air option (NITROJET 1000 LCV H). Features three digital readouts for set pressure, tyre pressure, and tyre count & error count. Reliable PSA method for nitrogen generation with automatic vacuum cum nitrogen inflation.
modelName: NITROJET 1000 LCV P / NITROJET 1000 LCV H
features: Three digital readouts one for set pressure, tyre pressure and other one for tyre count & error count
LCD display with back light to provide good visibility
Display remain at same set pressure value even at power on-off cycle
Audible and visual end of the cycle signal indicators
LED indication for the status of operation
Soft touch and durable membrane keys suitable for outdoor
Separate keys for set pressure increment and decrement
Flat key for empty or puncture tyre
VAC key (VACUUM KEY) for first time nitrogen filling
Computer power chord adapter with fuse protection and switch on indicator
Pressure switch for automatic nitrogen generation cut-off
Pressure gauge for input air pressure indication and internal tank nitrogen pressure indication
Safety valve available for internal tank
Reliable PSA method for nitrogen generation
Can use for vehicle tyre ranging from two wheeler, car, SUV and mini truck
